name: Sleep
description: Slow, soft pieces for winding down and drifting off: warm pads, breathing tides, lullabies, firesides, snowfall and noise blankets. Each piece unfolds over several minutes, slows down and fades to a close on its own, except the noise blanket, which loops for as long as you need it. No drums, no sudden changes, and gentle levels throughout.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Drifting Off
sketches.description: A warm pad drifting through F major, a few soft keys that forget themselves now and then, and light rain. The pad swells in, the keys grow sparser on the second pass, and everything slows and fades away.
sketches.source:
setcpm(50/4)

// The whole piece: a quiet intro, two long drifts and a slow settling, then silence
song("intro@8 drift@32 drift'@32 settle@16", "once")

// Steady, then easing down over the last sixteen cycles
tempomap("0:12.5 72:12.5 88:10")

// A warm pad drifting through Fmaj7, Dm9, Bbmaj7 and C6, swelling in and fading away
pad: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,e4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,a3]>").slow(2)
  .s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .attack(2).release(4).lpf(900).room(.8).size(.95)
  .gain(env(".04 .14@6 0", "song"))

// A few soft keys, now and then; half as many on the second drift
keys: n("<[4 ~ ~ 2] [~ 1 ~ ~] [0 ~ ~ ~] [~ ~ 2 ~]>").scale("F:major").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.3).seed("dream")
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.01).decay(1.5).sustain(0).release(2)
  .delay(.3).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.35).room(.7).gain(.2)
  .exceptSections("intro").variant(x => x.slow(2))

// A low root underneath, once the pad has arrived
bass: note("<f2 d2 bb1 c2>").slow(2).s("sine").attack(1).release(3).gain(.22)
  .exceptSections("intro")

// Light rain on the roof, softer at the edges
rain: s("rain").slow(4).intensity(.2).gain(bysec("intro:.12 settle:.1 *:.18"))

sketches.name: Tide of Breath
sketches.description: Breathe in as the tone rises, out as it falls, while waves roll in. The breathing starts at six breaths a minute and slowly eases to five, with far-off bells in the deepest part.

sketches.name: Starlight Lullaby
sketches.description: A slow music-box waltz in G, a hummed line beneath it and crickets far away. The tune comes round again an octave lower, then high and scattered, before a slowing coda.
sketches.source:
setcpm(54/3)

// One cycle is a bar of 3/4; the tune is eight bars long
song("intro@8 (tune@8)*2 tune'@8 (tune@8)*2 tune''@8 coda@8", "once")

// A gentle ritardando through the coda
tempomap("0:18 56:18 64:12")

// The music box: G D Em D C G D G; lower the first time round, high and scattered the second
musicbox: note("<[d5 b4 g4] [a4@2 d5] [b4 g4 e4] [d4@3] [e4 g4 c5] [b4@2 g4] [a4 f#4 d4] [g4@3]>")
  .s("sine").fm(2).fmh(4)
  .attack(.002).decay(1).sustain(0).release(1.5)
  .room(.7).size(.85).gain(.2)
  .exceptSections("intro")
  .variant(x => x.add(-12).gain(.16), x => x.add(12).degradeBy(.4).seed("star"))

// A soft root on the downbeat, from the very start
bass: note("<g2 d2 e2 d2 c2 g2 d2 g2>").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.01).decay(1).sustain(0).release(1).gain(.2)

// Someone humming along, a little louder when the music box changes octave and in the coda
hum: note("<g3 d3 e3 d3 c3 g3 d3 g3>").s("hum").attack(.6).release(1.5)
  .gain(bysec("tune':.16 tune'':.16 coda:.14 *:.1"))
  .exceptSections("intro")

// Crickets far away, fading as the song ends
crickets: s("insect").slow(4).distance(8).gain(env(".07@4 0", "song"))

sketches.name: Hearthside
sketches.description: Slow guitar arpeggios in D by a crackling fire, a hummed tune and a quiet clock. The fire is lit, the guitar plays twice with a different ending each time, and the last arpeggios slow down as the embers settle.

sketches.name: Delta Drift
sketches.description: Headphones on: a slow 2 Hz binaural drone, a dark pad that opens and closes, brown noise and distant bells. A long descent that sinks lower and slower before fading out.

sketches.name: Moonlit Lake
sketches.description: Scattered glass notes on still water, a low open fifth, a stream to the left and insects to the right. The water starts still, ripples twice (the second time lower and sparser) and fades into mist.
sketches.source:
setcpm(60/4)

// Still water, two ripples and a mist, then silence
song("still@8 ripple@24 ripple'@24 mist@16", "once")

// Slowing as the mist comes in
tempomap("0:15 56:15 72:12")

// A low open fifth, barely there
drone: note("[d2,a2]").slow(4).s("sine").attack(3).sustain(1).release(4).gain(.17)

// Glass notes scattered on the water; lower and sparser on the second ripple
glass: n(irand(5).segment(8)).scale("D:minor pentatonic").transpose(12)
  .degradeBy(.75).seed("lake")
  .s("triangle").timbre("glass").decay(1).sustain(0).release(2)
  .pan(rand).delay(.4).delaytime(3/8).delayfeedback(.45).room(.7)
  .gain(bysec("mist:.08 *:.14"))
  .exceptSections("still").variant(x => x.add(-12).slow(2))

// A stream on the left, insects on the right as the night deepens
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(-60).distance(4).gain(env(".2 .2@3 .1", "song"))
insects: s("insect").slow(4).azimuth(80).distance(5).gain(.08)
  .sections("ripple' mist")

sketches.name: Snowfall
sketches.description: A hushed choir in E minor, soft wind at the window and high bells falling like snowflakes. The choir pauses to let the snow fall alone, returns singing 'ah', and settles into a slow, quiet close.
sketches.source:
setcpm(46/4)

// First flakes, the choir twice with a hush and a drift between, a last verse and a settling
song("first@8 (snow@16 1.hush@8 2.drift@8)*2 snow'@16 settle@8", "once")

// Slowing as the snow settles
tempomap("0:11.5 72:11.5 80:9")

// Wind at the window, rising and falling over the whole night
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(env(".08 .13@4 .06", "song"))

// A hushed choir: Em, C, Am, B; silent in the hush, singing 'ah' in the last verse
choir: note("<[e3,g3,b3] [c3,e3,g3] [a2,c3,e3] [b2,d#3,f#3]>").slow(2)
  .s("choir").syl("<oo oo ah oo>")
  .attack(2).release(3).space("hall").gain(bysec("settle:.12 *:.2"))
  .exceptSections("first hush").variant(x => x.syl("ah"))

// A low root beneath the choir
bass: note("<e2 c2 a1 b1>").slow(2).s("sine").attack(2).release(4).gain(.18)
  .exceptSections("first")

// Snowflakes: high bells, a few at a time, until the snow settles
flakes: note("<[b5 ~ g5 ~] [~ e5 ~ ~] [~ ~ f#5 ~] [d#5 ~ ~ ~]>")
  .degradeBy(.25).seed("snow")
  .s("sine").fm(3).fmh(2.76).decay(2).sustain(0).release(2)
  .pan(rand).space("hall").gain(.07)
  .exceptSections("settle")

sketches.name: Brown Noise Blanket
sketches.description: A deep, steady blanket of filtered brown noise with a soft hum underneath, for masking the world and sleeping through. Unlike the other pieces it never ends: it loops for as long as you need it.
